# Honghui Du — computational mechanics research

> Author-maintained research pages on neural meshfree approximation, differentiable simulation, inverse modeling, and strain-gradient elasticity.

## Research guides

- [Methods, papers, and code](https://honghui-du.github.io/research/): Task-based guide, scope distinctions, and existing implementations.
- [中文研究导读](https://honghui-du.github.io/zh/research/): Chinese-language guide to the same research.
- [Publication list](https://honghui-du.github.io/publications/): Bibliographic overview.
- [Paper records](https://honghui-du.github.io/research/papers.json): Structured metadata generated from the publication pages.

## Existing software

- [NIM-Tutorial](https://github.com/IntelligentMechanicsLab/NIM-Tutorial): Selected NIM tutorials and examples.
- [JAX-MPM](https://github.com/IntelligentMechanicsLab/JAX-MPM): Selected differentiable MPM validation and friction-inversion examples.
